model.title: Childhood Diabetes Reduction Act of 2026
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-VT)

summary.text: The bill would require warning labels on sugary drinks, artificially sweetened products, ultra-processed foods, and items high in added sugar, saturated fat, or sodium to inform consumers about health risks like diabetes. It would also ban advertising these products to children and fund nutrition research and public education campaigns to promote healthier eating and exercise habits.
